subject: ClearOps Labs — EU tenant sweep and purge acceptance
messages:
From: Sara D'Angelo <sara@clearopslabs.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: compliance@clearopslabs.com
Date: 2028-04-20T09:12:00+02:00
Subject: Request: Full purge for tenant clearops-eu-77 (prompts, outputs, logs)

Hi Laura,

We need Redwood to execute a full data sweep for our EU tenant (clearops-eu-77). Scope: all prompt inputs, assistant outputs, runtime request logs, and KV/cache artifacts generated between 2027-01-01 and 2028-04-20. No legal holds on our side.

Questions:
- What is the end-to-end timeline for execution and proof delivery?
- Will the purge affect any backups or snapshots we should be aware of?
- What evidence will you provide that artifacts are removed (audit logs, manifests, signed attestation)?

I attached a simple manifest of top-level resource IDs to target (clearops_deletion_manifest_20280420.csv). Please advise next steps and the earliest available execution window.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara D'Angelo
Head of Security & Ops
ClearOps Labs

Attachment: clearops_deletion_manifest_20280420.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sara D'Angelo <sara@clearopslabs.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-20T09:45:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Request: Full purge for tenant clearops-eu-77 (prompts, outputs, logs)

Hi Sara — thanks for the details and the manifest.

High level next steps I recommend:
1) We validate the manifest against our tenancy map (we'll confirm exact object ids).
2) Ops executes a staged run (dry-run in a staging copy) and provides an execution window.
3) Production purge is scheduled with a short maintenance window; we'll capture per-object deletion receipts and a consolidated PDF report + signed attestation.

A couple of clarifying asks:
- Confirm whether any records are part of an active investigation or retention hold. You indicated none — please confirm in writing from your legal team if possible.
- Do you require zeroization of KV cache only (in-place) or a proof that ephemeral caches were flushed and cache keys removed from storage?

I'll loop in our ops and compliance folks to scope the run and propose dates. Expect a proposed window by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: ClearOps-Deletion-Manifest.xlsx (stub — internal template, 8KB)

From: Sara D'Angelo <sara@clearopslabs.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-20T10:30:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Request: Full purge for tenant clearops-eu-77 (prompts, outputs, logs)

Laura — confirmed. No ongoing investigations or legal holds. I have our GRC lead signing off in a separate email; will loop them if you need formal stamp. Cache zeroization should include KV eviction and removal of any snapshot keys.

I've attached a slightly expanded CSV with resource paths and tenant identifiers.

Thanks,
Sara

Attachment: clearops_deletion_manifest_20280420.csv (updated, 18KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-20T06:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: ClearOps purge request — please scope and schedule

Folks — forwarding ClearOps' request. TL;DR: EU tenant clearops-eu-77 needs a full sweep of prompts, outputs, runtime logs, and KV cache artifacts for 2027-01-01 through 2028-04-20. Customer confirmed no holds.

Please:
- Confirm whether snapshots/backups are within scope (ops to advise and propose safe handling).
- Provide a staging dry-run plan, proposed execution windows (EU nights preferred), and the exact evidence package we will deliver (per-object receipts, consolidated PDF, and signed attestation).
- Note any SLO impacts.

Customer contact: Sara D'Angelo <sara@clearopslabs.com>. Aim to reply to customer with a firm date/time by EOD tomorrow.

Laura

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-21T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: ClearOps purge request — staging dry-run & execution plan

Laura / team —

Thanks for the forward. Proposed plan:
1) Ops will validate the manifest against our EU tenancy index and run a non-destructive dry-run in the staging environment. Dry-run target: confirm mapping of resource IDs to objects and surface any orphaned derivatives.
2) Execution window: 2028-04-22 02:00–03:30 UTC (EU off-peak). We expect the actual run to complete within that window for this tenant size; we will keep throughput conservative to preserve SLOs.
3) Evidence package: per-object deletion receipts (csv), an execution trace log (audit_kv_sweep_log_YYYYMMDD.log), and a consolidated PDF report (clearops_purge_report_YYYYMMDD.pdf). We will also populate the erase_proof_template.txt with signed metadata (operator id, time, checksum).
4) Backups: we will not touch immutable backups. If ClearOps requires backup purging, procurement/legal must approve; we can coordinate a separate process.

Attachments: clearops_purge_run_manifest.json (internal run manifest), erase_proof_template.txt (proof template).

Please confirm the window with Sara; I'll kick off the staging dry-run once confirmed.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Sr. Runbook Engineer — Redwood Ops

Attachments:
- clearops_purge_run_manifest.json (internal, 4KB)
- erase_proof_template.txt (stub, 1KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-22T17:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: ClearOps purge execution — completed & evidence attached

Hi all — executing as scheduled: 2028-04-22 02:05–02:47 UTC.

Summary:
- Staged dry-run validated mappings on 2028-04-21; no orphaned derivatives beyond manifest.
- Production purge executed during proposed window.
- Deleted objects: 7,482 prompt records, 2,190 assistant-output artifacts, 14,306 runtime log entries (obfuscated for privacy), and KV cache entries enumerated in the audit log.

Evidence delivered:
- clearops_purge_report_20280422.pdf (consolidated report with timestamps and operator signatures)
- audit_kv_sweep_log_20280422.log (per-key removal trace — redacted where necessary)

Notes:
- We did not delete immutable snapshots/backups. If ClearOps requires removal of backups they own, we need an approved ticket and additional approval from our legal team.
- Attached a signed attestation at the end of the PDF.

Laura — please pass to the customer and close the ticket.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Principal Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- clearops_purge_report_20280422.pdf (PDF, 96KB)
- audit_kv_sweep_log_20280422.log (LOG, 44KB)

Sara —

We completed the purge for tenant clearops-eu-77 on 2028-04-22 during the agreed window. Deliverables attached: clearops_purge_report_20280422.pdf and the audit_kv_sweep_log_20280422.log. Marcus included a signed attestation inside the PDF.

Key reminders:
- Immutable backups were not modified; if you need those removed, reply and we'll coordinate the backup removal flow (legal approval required).
- If you require additional redaction proof for specific user-submitted prompts, let us know which IDs and we’ll attach per-record checksums.

Please confirm receipt and that the evidence package satisfies your compliance requirements. Once you confirm we'll mark the ticket closed.
